title: Report test-run registration failures by phase without changing durability semantics
outcome: Independently land Phase2a registration diagnostics: preserve existing 5s/8s deadlines and ACK/admission/settlement behavior while making POST/GET HTTP, abort, transport and host writer-fence failures actionable. Dedicated durable registration writes and exact no-start settlement remain parent Phase2b.
acceptance: Host registration failures log and report the phase, a concrete category, the total elapsed time, and the available writer progress, in bounded JSON. The 5 s and 8 s budgets are unchanged, and there is no ACK, admission or settlement behaviour change.

Deterministic Rust fence and real-HTTP launcher controls distinguish a POST abort, a POST HTTP error (including the host's reason), and a POST transport failure, and the same three for the GET. They prove that no test stage starts on a failure, and they preserve the exact durable-ACK positive path and idempotency.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact landed input, and the independent review pair is clean.

completion.summary: Landed phase-specific registration diagnostics without changing 5s/8s budgets, durable ACK, admission or settlement.
